en: Dependent on a cause that is a resultant phenomenon, there arises a non-cause, non-resultant phenomenon by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition, there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a cause that is a phenomenon liable to result, there arises a non-cause, phenomenon not liable to result by way of the root condition. Under the root condition, there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a non-cause, phenomenon neither resultant nor liable to result, there arises a non-cause, phenomenon neither resultant nor liable to result by way of the root condition. Under the root condition, there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are three.
